_help: Smart mode ranks whatever the CLIs currently offer: strongest family first, newest version first, preferred effort level. No model names are needed here. chains.<kind> = "auto" (default) or a manual list of {backend, match} rules. family_strength adds/overrides how strong a model family is (higher = better); unknown families get 50 and win on version number. exclude_words hides models from Smart. Sonnet-class models rank below Opus/Argon-class, so they act as the fallback. tier_economy.model = "auto-cheap" picks the weakest decent model.

tier_economy._help: When usage is high, the tiers listed here are moved to the economy model before the premium pools run out. High = any pool in premium_pools (claude_sub = Claude subscription, google:claude_gpt = Claude/GPT via Google, google:argon = Gemini 4 Argon) has less than min_left_pct percent left in its 5-hour or weekly window. Admins and people using their own key are never moved. Set tiers to [] to turn this off. Changes apply on the next message.
